//: Valhalla service config. Mounted read-only at /usr/local/etc/valhalla.json by infra/docker-compose.yml; tile extract built by scripts/valhalla_build.sh into .sandbox/data/valhalla (visible as /valhalla/tiles/valhalla_tiles.tar in the container).
//routing: Costing names here match backend/siren/routing.py COSTING_BY_TYPE: truck -> truck, motorbike -> motorcycle, patrol_car -> auto. VehicleProfile.valhalla_costing (contracts/db.sql) overrides these defaults per request (e.g. use_osm_trucking_on_road, dimensions, weight).

truck.//: Fire trucks need trucking access (unpaved/driveway edges) and must never cost haulage cheaply; static + interpolating costing both enabled so profiles can pick either per vehicle.

service.//: route is the only method SiREN calls (backend ValhallaClient POSTs /route); workers capped to 1 like the compose command.
